title: The prebiotic molecular inventory of Serpens SMM1. I. An investigation of the isomers CH<SUB>3</SUB>NCO and HOCH<SUB>2</SUB>CN
question: Investigate the interstellar chemistry of cyanides (CN) and isocyanates (NCO) and the reservoir of interstellar prebiotic molecules via the C2H3NO isomers CH3NCO and HOCH2CN towards Serpens SMM1-a and IRAS 16293B.

what.value: Spectroscopic line lists from JPL and CDMS databases

evidence.quote: Spectral line lists were obtained from the JPL database for molecular spectroscopy (Pickett et al. 1998), the Cologne Database for Molecular Spectroscopy (CDMS, Müller et al. 2001, 2005), and from literature.

external_data.citation: Pickett et al. 1998; Müller et al. 2001, 2005

what.value: Column densities of molecules in IRAS 16293B from PILS survey

evidence.quote: CH 3 OH and HNCO column densities were adopted from Jørgensen et al. (2018) and Coutens et al. (2016), respectively.

For IRAS 16293B, the analysis performed in this work is combined with results from Jørgensen et al. (2016); Coutens et al. (2016); Ligterink et al. (2017); Coutens et al. (2018); Persson et al. (2018); Calcutt et al. (2018); Jørgensen et al. (2018).

external_data.citation: Jørgensen et al. (2016, 2018); Coutens et al. (2016, 2018); Ligterink et al. (2017); Persson et al. (2018); Calcutt et al. (2018)

what.value: Local interstellar 12C/13C ratio of 52.5±15.4 and 16O/18O ratio of 560

evidence.quote: This is done by multiplying with the local interstellar 12 C/ 13 C ratio of 52.5±15.4 (Yan et al. 2019) and 16 O/ 18 O ratio of 560 (Wilson 1999).

what.value: Column densities of CH3NCO and HNCO towards G+0.693, Orion KL, G10.47+0.03, and Sgr B2(N)

evidence.quote: Column densities from the following publications are used: Belloche et al. (2013), Cernicharo et al. (2016), Ligterink et al. (2017), Belloche et al. (2017), Zeng et al. (2018), Gorai et al. (2020), and this work.

external_data.citation: Belloche et al. (2013, 2017); Cernicharo et al. (2016); Ligterink et al. (2017); Zeng et al. (2018); Gorai et al. (2020)

recipe.goal: Continuum subtraction and spectrum extraction for SMM1-a and IRAS 16293B
recipe.method: Image spectral windows without continuum subtraction, run STATCONT corrected sigma-clipping to locate line-free channels, run CASA uvcontsub in the uv-plane, re-image, and extract spectra at SMM1-a continuum peak and IRAS 16293B offset positions; also compute moment 0 maps integrated over 8 velocity bins.
key_parameters: Line-free bandwidth fraction: ≥20% (10% in two spectral windows)
assumptions: SMM1-a background temperature T_bg = 5.2 K from average continuum flux density (0.41 mJy beam^-1); IRAS 16293B T_BG = 21 K (full-beam offset) and 52 K (half-beam offset)

recipe.goal: Synthetic spectrum fitting and column density determination
recipe.method: Initial by-eye LTE synthetic spectrum fit in CASSIS using CDMS/JPL line lists, followed by MCMC chi-squared minimisation on optically thin unblended transitions to derive N_T, T_ex, V_LSR, and ΔV; scale optically thick main isotopologues from minor isotopologues.
key_parameters: T_ex free range: 50 – 350 K; N_T free range: two orders of magnitude centered on by-eye fit
IRAS 16293B: ΔV = 1.0 km s^-1 (fixed), V_LSR = 2.7 km s^-1 (fixed), θ_source = 0''.5, T_bg = 21 K
assumptions: Local thermodynamic equilibrium (LTE) and optically thin lines (τ ≪ 1.0)
Source size equal to beam size (beam filling factor = 0.5)
Isotopic ratios 16O/18O = 560 and 12C/13C = 52.5±15.4; T_ex = 200 K for SMM1-a upper limits

recipe.goal: Abundance ratio comparison and statistical distance calculation
recipe.method: Compute abundance ratios relative to CH3OH and HNCO and calculate statistical distances S_(X/Y) in sigma between molecular ratios in SMM1-a and IRAS 16293B.

answer_key.quantity: HOCH2CN column density N_T (IRAS 16293B full-beam offset)
HOCH2CN column density N_T (IRAS 16293B half-beam offset)

evidence.quote: These lines can approximately be fitted with synthetic spectra of N T = 3.0×10 15 cm −2 for T ex = 150 and 300 K.

score_reason: ALMA project codes, extraction coordinates for SMM1-a, software versions (CASA 5.4.0-70, STATCONT, CASSIS), spectroscopic catalog tags, transition lists, MCMC parameter bounds, and full best-fit tables are all explicitly provided; only minor imaging and uvcontsub channel-mask details are omitted.
rediscovery_reason: Both ALMA datasets (2018.1.00836.S and 2013.1.00278.S) are public, the line lists and CASSIS LTE fitting setup are thoroughly documented in the text and appendices, and the primary outputs are quantitative column densities and excitation temperatures.
